notes.title: Update notes for 20 May 2022
notes.notes:
Community asked for it and we delivered!

New features include:

 25 Brand new levels
 Difficulty modes (Very easy, Easy, Medium, Hard and for the hardcore gamers an Impossible mode)
 Global leaderboard
 Achievements
 Arrow to paddle to control ball direction on launch
 More pickup items
 Last five maps have a boss (spaceship) that shoots at you
 And much more
